normalization_rule: A provider clause may be mapped to a code only when its meaning is fully represented by that code/effect/scope. Nuanced or ambiguous language is normalized as campaign rule UNKNOWN with attributable evidence; downstream code MUST NOT guess.

effect_model.REQUIRE: The code's compliance predicate MUST be provably true before every consuming production stage. Missing/unverifiable proof is UNKNOWN and blocks where ready_forbidden_until_resolved=true.
effect_model.PROHIBIT: The code's violation predicate MUST be provably false before every consuming production stage. Missing/unverifiable proof is UNKNOWN and blocks where ready_forbidden_until_resolved=true.

signature_contract.edit_signature: SHA256_RFC8785_CANONICAL_JSON over source_sha256 + material timeline + layout + captions + visual_emphasis + disclosure_render; timestamps/IDs excluded.
signature_contract.accepted_comparison_population: READY, POSTED, or ARCHIVED clips only; EJECTED attempts do not satisfy uniqueness history.
signature_contract.NO_REUSED_EDIT: same campaign_id; any prior accepted identical edit_signature blocks.
signature_contract.UNIQUE_PER_ACCOUNT: same social_account_id; any prior accepted identical edit_signature blocks.
signature_contract.UNIQUE_PER_CAMPAIGN: same campaign_id; any prior accepted identical edit_signature blocks.

CAMPAIGN_AUTHORIZED_SOURCE_ONLY.unknown_handling: UNKNOWN/unverifiable compliance blocks the listed consuming stage; it never means compliant.
CAMPAIGN_AUTHORIZED_SOURCE_ONLY.structured_fact_or_field: sources.origin_type == CAMPAIGN_AUTHORIZED and immutable source_rights_campaigns row for the exact campaign
CAMPAIGN_AUTHORIZED_SOURCE_ONLY.production_block: source is not campaign-authorized for exact campaign

OWNER_OWNED_SOURCE_ONLY.unknown_handling: UNKNOWN/unverifiable compliance blocks the listed consuming stage; it never means compliant.

NO_THIRD_PARTY_SOURCE.structured_fact_or_field: sources.origin_type must be CAMPAIGN_AUTHORIZED or OWNER_OWNED; EXPLICITLY_LICENSED counts as third-party for this code
NO_THIRD_PARTY_SOURCE.production_block: source origin is EXPLICITLY_LICENSED or unverified

NO_PROFANITY.structured_fact_or_field: transcript/content lexical scan plus rendered caption text scan
NO_PROFANITY.compliance_proof: restriction_compliance proof_kind=TRANSCRIPT_LEXICAL_SCAN and QC campaign_restrictions PASS

BRAND_SAFE_ONLY.structured_fact_or_field: structured content-safety review over selected transcript excerpt, captions, title and visual context

NO_MISLEADING_CLAIMS.unknown_handling: UNKNOWN/unverifiable compliance blocks the listed consuming stage; it never means compliant.
NO_MISLEADING_CLAIMS.structured_fact_or_field: claims-evidence review for factual claims introduced/preserved in edit/caption/title
NO_MISLEADING_CLAIMS.production_block: unsupported or misleading claim detected; UNKNOWN blocks

NO_CROP.compliance_proof: restriction_compliance proof_kind=EDIT_OPERATION_AUDIT and QC face_crop/campaign_restrictions PASS
NO_CROP.production_block: any crop/reframe/pan/zoom/punch-in or unverifiable source framing

NO_SPEED_CHANGE.unknown_handling: UNKNOWN/unverifiable compliance blocks the listed consuming stage; it never means compliant.

NO_SPEED_CHANGE.production_block: any speed manipulation/time-stretch other than cut selection

NO_TEXT_OVERLAY.unknown_handling: UNKNOWN/unverifiable compliance blocks the listed consuming stage; it never means compliant.
NO_TEXT_OVERLAY.structured_fact_or_field: burned captions ARE text overlays; edit_plan.captions.enabled=false with chunks=[] and disclosure_render.overlay_events=[]
NO_TEXT_OVERLAY.compliance_proof: restriction_compliance proof_kind=CAPTION_OVERLAY_AUDIT and QC caption_overlap/campaign_restrictions PASS
NO_TEXT_OVERLAY.production_block: any burned caption/title/lower-third/disclosure overlay. If disclosure placement VIDEO/BOTH is also required, the rules conflict and edit planning blocks rather than weakening either rule.

NO_REUSED_EDIT.compliance_proof: restriction_compliance proof_kind=EDIT_SIGNATURE_COMPARISON and QC uniqueness PASS

UNIQUE_PER_ACCOUNT.compliance_proof: QC uniqueness PASS with exact account comparison scope

UNIQUE_PER_CAMPAIGN.compliance_proof: QC uniqueness PASS with exact campaign comparison scope

proof_enforcement: COMPLIANT requires a code-specific permitted proof_kind and non-empty proof_reference. OWNER_REVIEW additionally requires owner_review_resolution_id and is legal only where owner_review_can_resolve=true. NONE can never satisfy an applicable restriction; UNKNOWN/VIOLATION never become COMPLIANT.

placement_contract.seal_rule: A restriction code is legal only under its listed canonical rule key. The seal rejects wrong-key placement and duplicate semantic code placement; UNKNOWN nuanced provider language remains UNKNOWN rather than being moved or force-fit.

proof_reference_contract.storage: Every usable proof_reference identifies one immutable restriction_proof_artifacts row. Free-form strings are forbidden.
proof_reference_contract.hash_rule: proof_sha256 is the DB-verified SHA-256 of PostgreSQL jsonb canonical text over the proof artifact material fields excluding proof_sha256/created_at.
proof_reference_contract.common_binding: Referenced row must match restriction_code, proof_kind, campaign_id, rule_snapshot_id, candidate_id/source_id when applicable, target identity, subject_sha256, evidenced_at and result=COMPLIANT; evidenced_at must be no later than the consuming DB action/commit time.

RIGHTS_CAMPAIGN_LINK.required_relational_binding: exact source_rights.id + record_hash and source_rights_campaigns row for exact campaign

SOURCE_ORIGIN.required_relational_binding: exact sources.id + sources.sha256 and frozen origin_type predicate

CONTENT_SAFETY_REVIEW.required_relational_binding: proof subject_sha256 equals exact edit_plans.plan_hash being consumed; evidence_sha256 identifies immutable review artifact

CLAIMS_EVIDENCE_REVIEW.required_relational_binding: edit-plan proof binds plan_hash; posting proof binds clip id + exact recommendation_version + deterministic posting-content SHA-256

EDIT_OPERATION_AUDIT.required_relational_binding: proof subject_sha256 equals exact plan_hash plus direct DB edit-operation predicate

CAPTION_OVERLAY_AUDIT.required_relational_binding: proof subject_sha256 equals exact plan_hash plus direct DB caption/overlay predicate

EDIT_SIGNATURE_COMPARISON.required_relational_binding: proof subject_sha256 equals edit_plan.output.edit_signature_sha256 and direct/final accepted-signature enforcement remains authoritative

OWNER_REVIEW.required_relational_binding: PRECOMMIT only: immutable RESOLVED owner_actions resolution binds exact campaign_id + sealed rule_snapshot_id + candidate_id + restriction_code + legal target_type + reserved target_id + target_version + subject_sha256. restriction_proof_artifacts mirrors target_version and resolution_sha256; consumer must match actual committed target/version/hash and resolved_at/evidenced_at <= DB-authored commit/revision time.

proof_reference_contract.owner_review_terminal_fact: OWNER_REVIEW is PRECOMMIT evidence. Target row existence is NOT required at owner-action resolution. Candidate/source/campaign/sealed-rule/restriction context must already exist. The immutable owner resolution and proof mirror target_version and resolution_sha256 and grant nothing unless a later edit-plan/posting consumer matches exact target UUID/target_version/subject hash/context and chronology.

posting_stage_proof_contract.stage_driven: On any material recommendation revision, every active restriction whose consuming_stages contains posting requires exactly one fresh COMPLIANT posting_restriction_compliance entry.
posting_stage_proof_contract.content_hash: SHA-256 of PostgreSQL jsonb text for jsonb_build_object(caption, platform_title), evaluated on the NEW recommendation.
posting_stage_proof_contract.freshness: proof artifact target_type=POSTING_RECOMMENDATION, target_id=clip.id, recommendation_version=NEW recommendation_version, subject_sha256 equals NEW content hash, evidenced_at <= DB-authored recommendation_revised_at. Stale content/version proofs are rejected.
posting_stage_proof_contract.unchanged_claim_text: A material recommendation change that leaves caption/platform_title unchanged still requires a new proof artifact bound to the NEW recommendation_version; the subject_sha256 remains the same deterministic claim-content hash.
posting_stage_proof_contract.direct_compliance_mutation: Any mutation/removal/replacement of posting_restriction_compliance changes posting_recommendation and is fully revalidated; no caption/title-change shortcut exists.

POSTING_RECOMMENDATION.subject_sha256: canonical SHA-256 over caption + platform_title claim-content object

resolution_time_validation: candidate and source lineage already exist
rule snapshot belongs to campaign and has immutable campaign_rule_set_commits seal
restriction code occurs in exact sealed rule set
target type is legal for the code consuming stage
reserved target UUID parses as UUID
decision is COMPLIANT, VIOLATION, or UNKNOWN
owner_review_precommit_contract.consumption_rule: Review/proof grants nothing alone. Exact later target UUID/version/hash/campaign/rule/candidate/restriction must match and owner resolved_at/proof evidenced_at/proof created_at must be <= DB-authored target commit/revision time.
owner_review_precommit_contract.retroactivity: Forbidden: owner resolution and proof artifact must exist before the reviewed edit plan or recommendation version is committed.
